cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Lost in the Process
cards.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your parcel got caught between reception and dispatch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left it on the bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Dispatch handed it to transport without a receipt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Both departments are you. Call the bus company.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll report a failure across dispatch, transport and receipt control. They'll need to investigate all three.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For a wedding cake, we weigh the flour. Please put that mug down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quicker. I've used three mugs already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Show me the mug, and I'll weigh one mugful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.text: The birthday invitations failed during address verification.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wrote our old address on every one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The archive supplied an outdated location.

cards.title: Outside the Scope
cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

cards.title: The Approved Explanation
cards.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's fine. His parked bus rolled into the pond.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The parents will ask whether he was driving.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then 'The parked bus needs repairs; Mr Patel is fine.' Same sentence for the office. We don't need three versions of his afternoon.

cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. First, did your 'make it memorable' include rockets?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It included sparklers. Nothing that needed a trailer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When did you first mention the trailer limit? I need that date before we get to the delivery date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
